Paediatric endocrinologist
Main areas of specialisation:

  • Hormonal disorders
  • Diseases of the thyroid and adrenal glands
  • Growth problems in children, growth hormone
  • Disorders of puberty
  • Metabolic disorders and obesity
  • Metabolic bone disease

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society for Paediatric Endocrinology
  • Past president of the European Society for Paediatric Endocrinology (ESPE)
  • Head of the European education programme in paediatric endocrinology in developing countries

Oncologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Stomach cancer
  • Cancer of the oesophagus
  • Pancreatic cancer
  • Cancer of the gall bladder
  • Bowel cancer (colorectal cancer)
  • Thyroid cancer

Summary: Professor Ido Wolf is an outstanding oncologist, widely known internationally as a specialist in the diagnosis and treatment of malignant tumours of the digestive tract, thyroid cancer and colorectal cancer. He holds a Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree and has some 30 years of clinical experience.

Ido Wolf is head of the national cancer centre and a leading specialist at Assuta, Israel's largest clinic.

In his daily practice Ido Wolf applies the newest and most advanced treatment methods and uses leading protocols of targeted or immunological therapy, which often save patients' lives and considerably improve survival.

Ido Wolf practises actively, combining clinical work with research into cancers of the digestive organs. Clinical research under Professor Wolf's direction led to the identification of a protein that restrains the development of malignant pancreatic tumours and is potentially effective against other aggressive cancers. It proved to be a natural hormone produced by the kidneys and brain. The research showed that when this protein is administered, malignant growths shrink and subsequently stop spreading.

Professor Ido Wolf is a leading teacher at Tel Aviv University, lecturing to future oncologists. He takes an active part in many professional conferences. He has prepared more than 60 presentations for international scientific symposia and published more than 40 papers on treatment in oncology. He is an honorary member of numerous professional societies and associations.

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Israel (Doctor of Medicine, MD)
  • Advanced training at Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Advanced training at the Weizmann Institute of Science in Rehovot, Israel
  • Residency in the oncology department of the Chaim Sheba Medical Centre, Tel HaShomer, Israel
  • Advanced training in the study of new mechanisms of cancer development at UCLA, Los Angeles, California, USA

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Endocrine Society (IES)
  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy (ISCORT)
  • Israel Neuroendocrine Tumour Society (INETS)
  • American Association for Cancer Research (AACR)
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)

Specialisation: orthopaedic surgeon, oncologist, cancer surgeon, orthopaedic oncologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Orthopaedics
  • Orthopaedic surgery
  • Orthopaedic oncology
  • Treatment of bone cancer
  • Osteosarcoma, chondrosarcoma

Summary:

Professor Yehuda Kollender is a specialist of world class in orthopaedics, orthopaedic surgery and orthopaedic oncology. He holds the post of chief physician in the cancer surgery department of a medical centre. Over a 37-year career he has treated adults and children alike, dealing with cancers of the musculoskeletal system and with bone tumours, both primary and metastatic. Professor Kollender has performed thousands of successful operations, using both traditional surgical methods and the most modern advanced technologies, such as cryosurgery and the CyberKnife.

His main aim is the complete and successful resection of tumours while preserving the limbs and their function. Professor Kollender took his medical degree at Tel Aviv University and completed fellowships at leading medical centres in Israel and the United States. He also served as a military doctor in the paratroop forces of the Israel Defence Forces.

Today Professor Kollender is actively engaged in research, working with international orthopaedic societies and research centres in America and Europe. He is a well-known lecturer and the author of more than 90 publications in respected medical journals.

Education and clinical experience:

  • Faculty of medicine: Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation: Orthopaedic surgery at the Soroka medical centre, Beersheba, Israel
  • Service in the Israel Defence Forces: Physician to a paratroop regiment
  • Fellowship in cancer surgery: National cancer centre, Columbia University, USA
  • Fellowship in orthopaedics and cancer pathology: Armed Forces Institute of Pathology (AFIP), Maryland, USA

Academic and research work:

Professor Kollender teaches in the department of orthopaedics in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University. He is the author of more than 90 publications and has given more than 300 presentations at international orthopaedic forums and congresses.

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Orthopaedic Association
  • Israel Society of Paediatric Haematology and Oncology
  • European Musculo-Skeletal Oncology Society
  • European society of oncology
  • International society of soft tissue oncology
  • International society for limb salvage

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Professor Yehuda Kollender is known for his outstanding methods in orthopaedic and cancer surgery, thanks to which many patients have received medical care of the highest quality and improved their quality of life.

Ophthalmology, ophthalmologist, specialist in oculoplastic surgery

Main areas of specialisation

  • Plastic surgery of the eyelids
  • Treatment of eyelid disorders
  • Plastic surgery of the orbit
  • Treatment of injuries, damage and tumours of the orbit
  • Plastic surgery of the tear ducts
  • Treatment of damage to the tear ducts
  • Amblyopia (lazy eye)
  • Blepharospasm
  • Short-sightedness, long-sightedness, astigmatism
  • Eye disease
  • Glaucoma
  • Diseases of the cornea and orbit
  • Diseases of the vitreous body
  • Tumours of the eyelids
  • Drooping of the upper eyelid (ptosis)
  • Fractures of the orbit
  • Cancer of the eye
  • Cancer of the orbit
  • Chalazion

Summary

Professor Igal Leibovitch is a leading ophthalmologist and a specialist of international standing in oculoplastic surgery. He applies the most modern methods of treating injuries, damage and tumours of the orbit. A doctor with rich clinical experience, he is known both in Israel and abroad.

Professor Leibovitch holds key positions at the Ichilov medical centre in Tel Aviv:

  • Head of the institute of oculoplastic surgery
  • Head of the inpatient unit of the ophthalmology department
  • Chairman of the examination board in ophthalmology

Education and medical practice

  • Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem
  • Fellowship in ophthalmology at the Hadassah Ein Kerem hospital, Jerusalem
  • Fellowship in eyelid oculoplastic surgery at the Jules Stein Eye Institute, UCLA, USA

Additional information

Professor Leibovitch is actively engaged in research, publishes papers in international medical journals and speaks regularly at specialist conferences. He is regarded as an expert in his field and often advises on complex cases, being called into case conferences to help reach the best treatment decisions.

Membership of professional organisations

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Ophthalmological Society
  • European Society of Ophthalmology
  • American Academy of Ophthalmology

Professor Leibovitch is one of the leading specialists in ophthalmology and oculoplastic surgery, whose professional work and contribution to medical science are recognised in Israel and internationally.

Rheumatologist

Main areas of specialisation

  • Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)
  • Rheumatoid arthritis
  • Gouty arthritis
  • Psoriatic arthritis
  • Ankylosing spondylitis
  • Osteoporosis
  • Gout
  • Treatment of acquired rheumatic heart disease

Summary

Professor Ilan Bank is one of Israel's best rheumatologists and an internationally known specialist in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of acute and chronic diseases of the joints and connective tissue, and in immunology and internal medicine. He has some 45 years of experience, during which he has given thousands of consultations to patients from countries around the world. His considerable professional experience allows Professor Bank to reach accurate diagnoses and prescribe effective treatment for rheumatological conditions, through which patients are relieved of suffering and recover in the shortest possible time.

Having graduated with distinction from Tel Aviv University, Ilan Bank left for a long fellowship in the United States, where he took advanced training in internal medicine and rheumatology at Columbia University. Seven years of service in the Israel Defence Forces also contributed to the development of this remarkable doctor's expertise.

Ilan Bank is a professor of medicine and a well-known and much sought-after teacher who lectures at Tel Aviv and Columbia universities. He also leads medical research. Professor Bank became known worldwide for his discovery in 1986 of new immune cells responsible for recognising and defending the body against bacteria, viruses and tumour cells. In the view of the respected journal Science, this discovery was the most important of the past 30 years. The finding is today used worldwide in treating various rheumatic and autoimmune diseases, in dermatology and haematology, and in the treatment of many infectious diseases.

Education and clinical experience

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Seven years of service as a doctor in the Israel Defence Forces
  • Fellowship in internal medicine and rheumatology at Columbia University, New York, USA

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English

Endocrinologist, senior physician and leading specialist of the endocrinology department

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Treatment of thyroid disease, including cancer
  • Treatment of diabetes
  • Treatment of osteoporosis
  • Treatment of hirsutism
  • Hormonal and lipid disorders
  • Other endocrine disorders

Summary:

Professor Ilana Izhakov is a specialist of international standing in endocrinology. She has more than 29 years of clinical practice, during which she has treated thousands of patients of all ages and given tens of thousands of consultations. Professor Izhakov is an excellent diagnostician, and her opinion is valued highly among doctors at Israel's leading medical centres.

In treatment she uses the newest drugs and developments in international pharmacology, which allows the best possible result in the shortest time.

Education and clinical experience:

Professor Izhakov took her medical degree in 1988. She completed a residency in internal medicine at the Ichilov hospital, where she also specialised in endocrinology.

Today Professor Izhakov is a well-known researcher and the author of many scientific and popular papers. She takes an active part in international conferences, exchanging experience with colleagues and bringing the newest techniques into her practice.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Israel Society of Internal Medicine
  • Israel Endocrine Society
  • Israel society for the treatment and prevention of atherosclerosis
  • European Society of Endocrinology
  • American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists
